_readme: Every number the model, generator and RVS use. status: sourced | assumption | needs_quote | needs_pilot | blank. NEVER present non-sourced values as fact. All data in this project is SIMULATED.

single_use_mailer_vnd.note: Size-matched to the 30x40 reusable bag. Lazada 'Tui goi hang niem phong co san keo tu dinh (500gr)', The KA Shop (HCMC), 5-6 zem: 25x35 = 30,900 VND / ~50 bags = ~620; 28x42 = 30,900 / ~39 = ~790; seller says these two sizes are for clothing (1-4 sets). Average ~705. Accessed 2026-10-17. URL to be copied.

single_use_box_vnd.note: Plain kraft mailer box 30x20x5 cm (clothing size), Lazada, accessed 2026-10-17: Nghe An seller ~2,350/box, NANA BOX (HCMC) 34,300/10 = ~3,430, ECONOPOSTAL (Hanoi) ~4,610. Median ~3,400. Old value 1,000 (Vietbox 10x10x5) was too small for clothing.

box_categories.note: Bulky categories assumed to ship in a box; others in a mailer.

reusable_pack_vnd.note: Median wholesale of Lazada.vn 30x40 zip bags: Ziplock HD 7 zem 92,000/kg / 55 pcs = 1,673; PE zipper hot xoai 88,000/kg / 40 pcs = 2,200 (khanghuystore). Public listing, not a quote. accessed 2026-10-16. Conservative: 8,300 (retail combo 3 for 25,000).

reuse_cycles.note: Thin 7-zem zip bag, not a purpose-built reusable mailer. Park & Waqar (2022) 20 cycles applies to purpose-built mailers. Sensitivity 5 / 20.

cleaning_per_reuse_vnd.note: Upper-bound estimate: public HCMC laundry per kg (Giat Say Thong Minh 8-10k/kg, tiemgiat.com 65k/7kg, giatuisaigon.com 12k/kg; median ~9,300/kg) x 18 g pack. Real cleaning (wipe/rinse) likely cheaper. Not a pilot. accessed 2026-10-16.

unrecovered_pack_loss_share.note: Share of the reusable pack price lost when a pack is NOT recovered (roughly half its life remaining). Was 1.0 (full price). Run 1.0 as worst-case sensitivity.

reusable_pack_vnd_conservative.note: Lazada.vn '[HCM] Tui zip lua mo 30x40 combo 3 cai' 25,000 VND / 3. Retail. accessed 2026-10-16.

single_use_mailer_vnd_small.note: Previous base: Shopee listing, 100 pcs for 48-50k VND, likely a small size (~20x30, comparable K&S 20x30 = ~400). Kept as lowest-cost sensitivity.

returning_item_carries_pack.note: Coolmate collects returns by courier from the customer (coolmate.me 60-day policy), so the pack can ride back with the item at ~0 extra cost. Brands in general: assumption.

ghn_tariff_vnd.note: GHN Express 0-2,000 g incl. VAT, effective 07/11/2025, via nhanh.vn/bang-gia-van-chuyen (secondary source); ghn.vn confirms 'tu 15,5k/don'. accessed 2026-10-16.

route_km_thresholds.note: Dataset has distance but no origin province; warehouse assumed HCMC. <=30 km noi tinh, 30-60 noi vung, >60 lien vung. Replace with real province once brands upload addresses.

pickup_order_share.note: GHN 'Phi tao don thu hoi' = 50% of outbound fee (same for Viettel Post). Cost of a courier pickup of the empty pack.

pack_collection_method.note: courier_pickup = pay pickup_order_share; dropoff = customer returns pack on next delivery / drop point at ~0 cost (recovery then uses dropoff_recovery_target).

failed_delivery_return_free.note: GHN, SPX, Best: 'mien phi chuyen hoan'. A refused (bom) parcel comes back free, pack unopened.

failed_delivery_rate.note: VECOM via Nguoi Lao Dong/Tuoi Tre 19/07/2025: 'bom hang' 8-12% (up to 20% remote areas). tuoitre.vn/nld/nhuc-nhoi-nan-bom-hang-19625071822023801.htm. accessed 2026-10-16. Expert (ThS Tran Anh Tung) 10-15%, 25-30% at promo peaks. Ex-ante only: rows with status Delivered are by definition not bom.

single_use_kg.note: DO NOT ENTER an unsourced number.

reusable_kg_per_use.note: DO NOT ENTER an unsourced number. Reusable is not automatically lower-carbon.

weights_v2.note: Adopted by the team (2026-10-17). RVS v2 = 0.55 cost advantage + 0.30 pack return probability + 0.15 reuse cycles. Replaces deck v1 (return 0.35, cycles 0.25, cost 0.25, distance 0.15): return probability was counted twice and distance barely changes cost. Guard: never REUSABLE if reusable is more expensive.

cost_full_score_saving.note: Saving of 25% of the single-use pack cost earns the full 100 cost points.

target_return_rate.note: POST-DELIVERY return rate. Coresight 24.4% (US apparel). US proxy; no strong Vietnam source for post-delivery returns (Sapo blog: fashion 8-12% 'under control'). Sensitivity 0.10.

base_return_rate_by_category.note: Dress ~38% and tees ~12% anchored to US benchmarks (eightx roundup); the rest interpolated. CROSS-CHECK (real data, fit feedback not returns): ModCloth misfit rate tops 0.34, outerwear 0.34, bottoms 0.30, dresses 0.27; RentTheRunway dress 0.28, pants 0.38, coat 0.40 (Misra, Wan & McAuley, RecSys 2018). Sizing problems are similar across categories (~0.27-0.34), so the large category spread here comes from benchmarks, not from fit. Sensitivity with fit-based rates: conclusions unchanged (courier 0% / drop-off 73.5% reusable wins).

odds_multipliers.note: multi_size direction supported by Dressipi 2022; COD effect in Vietnam unverified.

customer_trait_sd.note: Per-customer log-odds noise; makes past returns predictive.

multi_size_prob_by_category.note: Source file had these blank for 4,989 rows.

pack_recovery_target.note: Park & Waqar (2022), Canadian mailer, 30% loss. Sensitivity 0.95 = RePack self-reported with deposit + letterbox return (Circle Economy, 17/01/2025).

recovery_returned_item_log_odds.note: Customers already returning the item are more likely to send the pack back.

dropoff_recovery_target.note: Recovery if no courier pickup and the item is not returned (customer must act on their own).

non_cost_value._readme: Value (VND per order) that reusable gets credit for beyond direct cost. pack_weight_kg, fs_vnd_per_kg and mandatory_recycling_rate are SIMULATED illustrative values (status=assumption), NOT sourced. Replace with sourced values when available. Do NOT tune them to make reusable win.

pack_weight_kg.note: 1 kg / 55 pcs (30x40 Ziplock HD 7 zem, Lazada khanghuystore listing).

fs_vnd_per_kg.note: SIMULATED. Placeholder, not the official Fs.

mandatory_recycling_rate.note: SIMULATED. Placeholder, not the Decree rate.

admin_share.note: Management cost = 2% of recycling cost (Decree 05/2025, per Conventus Law summary).

epr_applies_to_client.note: Coolmate projected 2022 revenue ~USD 19M (VIR 2022) >> VND 30bn exemption threshold.

other_value_vnd_per_order.note: Demo zero. Reserved for waste-handling fee, brand value, etc. once sourced.

client_profile._readme: Target client used to frame the demo. Public facts only; NOT Coolmate's own order data. The order dataset stays the team's simulated data.

name.note: Vietnamese fashion brand, founded 2019, D2C model (Vertex Ventures, 03/11/2025).

business_model.note: Sells through its own website, so it controls its own packaging. Vertex Ventures 03/11/2025: https://www.vertexventures.sg/news/coolmate-secures-series-c-funding-marking-a-new-growth-chapter-for-a-vietnamese-brand/ (accessed 2026-10-17).

orders_per_day.note: 'up to 10,000 orders per day', VIR 13/05/2022: https://vir.com.vn/coolmate-secures-2-million-in-series-a-funding-93459.html (accessed 2026-10-17). 2022 figure.

total_orders_delivered.note: 'more than 5 million orders delivered across Vietnam' over 6 years, Vertex Ventures 03/11/2025.

repeat_purchase_share.note: 'over half of all purchases come from returning buyers', VIR 2022. Our simulated data: 60% of orders come from customers with an earlier order.

revenue_2022_usd.note: Projected 2022 revenue, VIR 2022. ~440-460 billion VND, far above the 30 billion VND EPR exemption threshold.

product_lines.note: Vertex Ventures 2025. NOT applied to the simulated data: its categories (incl. Dress, Outerwear) come from the team template; remapping needs a data change.

return_policy_days.note: Returns/exchanges within 60 days of receipt, any reason, up to 3 times per order; excludes outlet, custom print, Sale/Deal, Basics and pack items. https://www.coolmate.me/page/dich-vu-60-ngay-doi-tra (accessed 2026-10-17).

return_fee_charged_to_customer_vnd.note: 25,000 VND shipping fee deducted from the refund 'nếu có' (if applicable). So returns are not always free for the customer.

return_collection.note: Coolmate confirms by phone, customer hands the item to a courier. A reusable pack can ride back with the returned item.

value: Hanoi Operations Center: Lot C8, Lai Yen Industrial Park, Hoai Duc, Hanoi
HCMC Office & Operations Center: Lot C3, D2 Street, Cat Lai Industrial Park, Thu Duc City, HCMC
warehouse_location.note: Coolmate contact addresses (coolmate.me, URL to be copied; accessed 2026-10-17). Two operations centres, north and south. Simulation still uses one route rule from distance; with two centres more orders would be noi tinh / noi vung, which only changes pickup cost slightly (15,500 vs 18,000-19,000).

current_packaging_and_cost.value: Recycled-plastic poly mailer (since end of 2023); earlier biodegradable bags, black paper boxes and a wheat-starch 'Smart Bag' (2020)
current_packaging_and_cost.note: coolmate.me blog 22/11/2023: replaced bio bags with recycled plastic bags, 'gia thanh cua nhung tui recycle rat dat' (very expensive), no price given. coolmate.me blog 31/05/2020: Smart Bag costs 1.5-2x a normal nylon bag, has a zip and can be reused by the customer. Sensitivity (cost only, return 24%): if Coolmate's single-use bag costs 735 VND (1.5x 490) instead of 490, reusable via drop-off becomes cheaper on ~100% of orders (vs 18%); courier pickup still 0%.

presets._readme: Demo presets. Each overrides only the listed values; everything else uses the base config. Brands pick the closest preset at onboarding, then enter their own numbers.

brand_premium.label: Brand premium, mailer berlogo
brand_premium.note: Lazada Hanoi 'in tui nilong theo yeu cau (in tu 200c)' 1,200 VND/bag, MOQ 200, size not stated. Approximation, not Coolmate's own cost.

brand_premium_box.label: Brand premium, kotak
brand_premium_box.note: Plain kraft box 30x20x5 median ~3,400 VND. Branded/printed boxes (as in Coolmate unboxing videos) cost more.
